item.title: This pioneering sushi chef’s final venture may be the newest omakase restaurant to land in Mountain View
item.description: Masaki Sasaki is a legend in the Bay Area omakase scene. Known as Chef Masa, his Michelin-starred restaurant Maruya was the first to introduce the style of dining to San Francisco in 2013. Sasaki, now 68 years old, will open his 15th – and likely final – restaurant on March 7: Sushi Adachi. The post This pioneering sushi chef’s final venture may be the newest omakase restaurant to land in Mountain View appeared first on Palo Alto Online.

item.title: Palo Alto struggles to reach key climate goal despite progress
item.description: Palo Alto leaders approved a climate action workplan for the next two years on Monday night, while simultaneously debating the viability of its ambitious climate goals for 2030 that are proving more out of reach with each passing year. item.title: Mia’s Paletería y Nevería brings hard-to-find Mexican treats to Mountain View
item.description: Mia’s Paletería y Nevería, which directly translates to “Mia’s popsicle and ice cream store,” held its grand opening in November. Its ice cream reflects a Mexican palette that showcases unique flavors you would not find at most of your local grocery stores or favorite ice cream shops. item.title: City stalls on enforcing ‘daylighting’ law
item.description: Parking within 20 feet of an intersection is mostly prohibited in California, thanks to a state bill that went into effect in January 2025.
